Je m'appelle Zora KOVAC, je tiens la bou:
My name is Zora KOVAC, I have run the bakery for seven years.

I don't make the coupons, I take them. If a customer hands me a stamped coupon, I give them their bread. That's the rules. I don't ask everyone whether they're alive.

Since the autumn, there have been people I don't know. They pay with brand-new books and they always take the maximum. I told the inspector already in September. He told me it wasn't my job to think.

My son is doing his service. I haven't done anything.
